title: Prompt Caching: Stop Paying Full Price for Repeats
description:
Sending the same long prompt again and again? Stop paying full price for it. 💸

✅ Caching reuses the unchanged start of your prompt
✅ Mark the big, stable part with cache_control, type ephemeral
✅ Cached reads cost far less than normal input

Day 9 of Token Saver! Next up, Day 10: Use Subagents to Keep Context Clean.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to spend fewer tokens with AI.

#shorts #ai #claude #aicoding #promptengineering #aitools #coding #learntocode
comment: Cache or no cache: which do you try first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: put the big unchanging text at the start of your prompt and the changing question last, so the cached part stays the same.
